style.backgroundSystem: illustrated coral orange #F07B4E cartoon sky for cover and closing panels, clean white #FFFFFF boards for packshot and flat lays, cream apricot #FBE9CE panels for infographic and scene shots
style.iconSystem: flat cartoon cloud, wave and dotted-path motifs with small numbered round badges in a single accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with a front key and soft contact shadows on all photography panels; even flat light on infographic panels
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm playful kids-apparel ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of coral orange #F07B4E, cream apricot #FBE9CE, warm sand #F5C893 and charcoal text #3A3A3A over clean white #FFFFFF bases; bright soft studio lighting with a front key and soft contact shadows on every photography panel and even flat light on infographic panels; rounded friendly geometric sans-serif typography; simple flat cartoon cloud, wave and dotted-path motifs with small numbered round badges; product photography framed inside rounded-corner image slots; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: garments framed inside rounded-corner image slots; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte white board and smooth cream apricot backdrop, garments neatly smoothed flat
style.typography: rounded friendly geometric sans-serif with pinyin-style small captions
